title: Service secret profiles (dormant)
description: Dormant offline profile enumeration for service secret bindings. Not referenced by values.schema.json or any template; catalog stays []. Normative shape remains approval.secretReferences/secretBindings/composition.secrets with ExternalSecrets fixed to store cloudlab/ClusterSecretStore, refreshInterval 24h, creationPolicy Owner, deletionPolicy Retain. Creates no vault items, credentials, or catalog entries.

profile.description: ordinary = approval.secretBindings on charts/service; composition = approval.composition.secrets. Notes takes neither.

destination.description: ExternalSecret/Secret name; must be listed in approval.secretReferences.

item.description: Vault item key (name only, never values).

fields.description: K8s key -> vault field map. At most 8 bindings per approval; at most 16 secretReferences.
